title: Converting devices to USB Type-C
summary: DIY Perks shows how to modify devices that use older USB connectors so they charge and connect over USB Type-C. He solders in a USB-C connector board and works through cases such as dongle-dependent gadgets and a mouse receiver.
why: Commenters cite it as a well-made, practical example of USB-C conversion when they discuss hacking USB-C into devices.

quote.text: made a video about converting USB connectors to USB C which is very well done
